timing: Linux clock_getcpuclockid(workerd PID) + clock_gettime_ns through a separate Python helper; whole-process CPU, not wall or platform quota
boundaries: Exactly one phase is enabled per handshake; each span still includes local marker/RPC overhead; empty-marker control is measured, not blindly subtracted
Selected phase includes its uninstrumented children; phases measured on different handshakes must not be summed as exact partitions
Other workerd threads and runtime/GC CPU are included; nanosecond units/resolution are not a nanosecond accuracy guarantee
Baseline measurements do not execute markers or phase wrappers
The complete pinned root index is augmented only with the local fixture root in an isolated bundle
All sources and networking are local; no production implementation or trust roots changed
